why: Plate bakes (geo-pos.f32, geo-id.u8, plate images, place.json under capture/) are renders that take minutes each and stay untracked. These tests read one and skip where it is absent. They run on a checkout that has the bakes. A test may join this list only with an issue that says how it will run.
